from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6ff9a296.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Connect aligned occurrences of each non-background marker with color 3."""
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg}
    for color in colors:
        for r in range(h):
            cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
            if len(cols) >= 2:
                for c in range(min(cols), max(cols) + 1):
                    if grid[r][c] == bg:
                        out[r][c] = 3
        for c in range(w):
            rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == color]
            if len(rows) >= 2:
                for r in range(min(rows), max(rows) + 1):
                    if grid[r][c] == bg:
                        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
